Needs changes before merge.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3008` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/transport.rs:201`: The PR changes AI turn undo and confirmation behavior. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add images that show the changed undo behavior and the machine-edit confirmation. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit review images to this PR branch.

The grouped commands undo in reverse order. The approval check binds the tool name and arguments. The UI passes selection data through the app API.

Local results:

- Tested head `f37a111680aa81220db4873f202318269f8be81c` against `upstream/main` at `e808c96299ef7e1edb3206d327acc270847a8a18`. The trial merge reported `Already up to date.`
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test batch_undo --test mcp_live --test mcp --test mcp_provider --no-run`: passed.
- The four app suites passed: `batch_undo` 3, `mcp_live` 14, `mcp` 22, and `mcp_provider` 9.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib --test commands_undo`: 355 library tests and 30 command tests passed. One library test was ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 968 passed, 6 ignored.
- App clippy passed with `--lib --bins --test batch_undo --test mcp_live --test mcp --test mcp_provider -- -D warnings`.
- UI clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Combined clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` failed in the unchanged `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs`. This file is identical to upstream main. The compiler reported:

```text
error[E0308]: mismatched types
   --> crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:107:19
expected `Option<WorkMaterial>`, found `WorkMaterial`

error[E0063]: missing fields `stepdown` and `stepover` in initializer of `camcraft_app::tool_cutting_rows::CuttingRow`
   --> crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106:15
```

Safety checks:

- Bypassed `LiveGate::check`. `live_permission_gate_blocks_unapproved_post_file_writes_paths_and_machine_limits` failed because an unapproved post wrote `blocked.nc`. Restored the source. The test passed.
- Made `GateKind::allows_auto_approve` return `true`. `live_gate_allows_explicitly_approved_calls_and_never_auto_approves_post_or_machine_edits` failed because posting was auto-approved. Restored the source. The test passed.
- No G-code, CL, or golden files changed. There were no moved goldens to compare.
- The review worktree has no remaining tracked changes.

The quick gate plan was read with `--dry-run`. The full quick gate, batch gate, release gate, and external LLM API calls were not run. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added the missing before/after screenshots for grouped AI-turn undo and machine-edit confirmation. The four images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `775c2b7ce0ff9d017a6161fd6784fe901bfae2a1` and are linked in the PR body.

- Undo: one Ctrl+Z previously left the stock and tool; it now removes all three turn edits. Pinned by `one_ctrl_z_reverts_multi_call_ai_chat_turn`. Reverting group folding failed the pin; restoring it passed.
- Machine edit: loading previously ran without confirmation; it now waits for Allow/Deny. Pinned by `machine_and_limit_edits_require_confirmation_and_unapproved_live_dispatch_blocks`. Reverting the Native guard failed the pin; restoring it passed.

These are real egui shell renders with offline ScriptedTransport. The PR body describes the temporary reversions used for the before captures. All capture edits were restored. No evidence files were committed to this PR branch.

Head: `f37a111680aa81220db4873f202318269f8be81c` (unchanged; this finding required evidence only). Plain push reports up to date. The PR remains a draft.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 271/273 steps passed. The two failures are the existing branch `wire_tool.rs` compile errors in app no-run and its individual suite. Upstream has since fixed that fixture in `018aef2b4`; this evidence-only fix leaves it untouched. Combined all-target clippy hits the same errors. Scoped app clippy (lib, bins, batch_undo, mcp_live, mcp, mcp_provider) and UI all-target clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

Please re-review the screenshot finding on this unchanged head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f37a111680aa81220db4873f202318269f8be81c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review checks the new evidence on the same head. The later Addressed comment answers the earlier screenshot finding.

- The PR body now links four before/after screenshots from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
- I opened all four images. They show the changed undo behavior and the machine-edit confirmation.
- The before images show the tool remaining after Undo and a machine loaded without confirmation.
- The after images show the tool removed after Undo and machine loading waiting for Allow or Deny.
- The body explains the temporary reversions used for the before images. The PR contains no screenshot or review evidence files.
- The earlier finding is met. No requested changes remain.

Local results:

Tested in `.claude/worktrees/review-2260`, with a clean trial merge of upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f`.
I used the current upstream `AGENTS.md` for the rule check.

- The app build with `--no-run` passed for the library and the five selected test suites.
- App library: 356 passed, 1 ignored.
- `batch_undo`: 3 passed. `commands_undo`: 30 passed.
- `mcp`: 22 passed. `mcp_live`: 14 passed. `mcp_provider`: 9 passed.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: the first run had 967 passed, 1 failed, and 6 ignored.
- The failed test was `egui_app::tests::setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`.
- It failed at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1495` with this message:

```text
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4).
```

- That test passed on an isolated retry. A second full UI library run passed: 968 passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. The full gate was not run.

Safety checks:

This is a safety-tier review because the gate controls G-code posting and machine edits.
I repeated two mutations from the PR body on the trial merge.

1. Bypassed `LiveGate::check`. `live_permission_gate_blocks_unapproved_post_file_writes_paths_and_machine_limits` failed because an unapproved post wrote `blocked.nc`. I restored the source. The test passed.
2. Made `GateKind::allows_auto_approve` return `true`. `live_gate_allows_explicitly_approved_calls_and_never_auto_approves_post_or_machine_edits` failed because posting was auto-approved. I restored the source. The test passed.

No G-code, CL, or golden files changed in this PR. There were no changed golden lines to check.
The source has no remaining changes from the mutations.
All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used. External LLM API calls and release tests were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
